ideas.label: Coordination
ideas.principle: Make every piece serve the plan
ideas.summary: - Coordinate pieces so they cover one another and share one plan. - Improve the piece that cannot yet change roles without losing key squares.

slots.worked: your pieces already support one shared plan
slots.attention: at least one piece still fails to cover the others or the plan
slots.lesson: make every piece serve the same plan and cover the others
slots.plan: improve the least useful piece before inventing a new attack
